content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm working to enable our customers to control devices from tablet PCs and their own mobile phones. For this purpose, I need Android software. In the example I shared below, the web browser's address bar is causing problems. Is it possible to use a simple app to access the personalized [product_name] page directly? Does such an application exist? All my [product_name] IP settings are the same and set to 192.168.100.100. Best regards.

Hello [user_name], Please discuss your question in English as this is an international community and we aim to keep communication in one language. Posting in English will help you receive more responses. Here is the translated version of your question. Regards, [user_name]_Moderator

I initially wrote my post in English, but auto-translate in Google Chrome seems to have changed it. I believe that's what caused the issue. Hello everyone, I'm trying to give our customers the ability to control devices from tablet PCs and their own mobile phones. For this, I require Android software. In the example below, the web browser's address bar is problematic. Is there a simple app that allows direct access to a personalized [product_name] page? Is such an application available? All my [product_name] IP settings are the same: 192.168.100.100 Kind regards.

analysis.insight_summary: The user aims to provide customers access to control [product_name] devices via Android tablets and smartphones. The main challenge is the browser's address bar interfering with the mobile web interface. The user seeks an Android application that would allow direct, customized access to the [product_name] web page, eliminating browser navigation interruptions for a streamlined experience.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy-to-use Android solution for uninterrupted, direct access to personalized [product_name] control pages, avoiding complications from the browser interface.
